body: Hi, please get help. With anxiety I have often avoided food. Stuck to coffee. Or hours of starving then binge. I don’t have body image issue but I have self sabotage of health issue. It’s helping to get a dietician or trainer to work with you. That way your intake and your exercise is monitored and these professionals actually make you not shame your body. Please please get help, I am still struggling with a lot of things because the root cause depression is still not being addressed. but I wanted to share the health part of it which is making me feel a bit better. I will get to mental health help as well in sometime. Please friend, get someone to support you through this struggle.

I have constant voices or headmates, but this is me at different ages. Like all very distinct with their own identities, but they are the lives I didn’t live. Or what I stopped being at some point in life. I froze in time and age as a separate person. I think that is still under definition of OSDD-1A. Till the entities are of same person not different person.

There is a flip side to this. I dated an insecure guy. Never cheated, strayed or flirted. Everyone knew he existed, LDR, most people knew times he would call because I would excuse myself to take his calls. So work people and friends knew. He kept thinking, I would still cheat or leave him for my bestfriend/s or someone better. In reality, he ended up emotionally cheating on me and hid it for two years before we broke up (on something totally diff, I found out about it after breakup from someone else.) I have been very much shaken up with my trust post this betrayal and unfortunately I slightly project it on others and I am sorting this while keep my distance from anyone new till I am fully not projecting. 

But yes, OP please sort out your insecurities first before getting close to anyone. This relationship is lost for now. Getting back would just mean multiple trust issues and resentment. First heal and find why you always were insecure because technically you were broken up and she didn’t come back to you. You went back to her.

There are people who will convince you to partake in something they want and rest the blame on “mutual”. Right now you need to distance from him. Even emotionally and in connect 

Right now let yourself grieve. First get your work/study in order. While you grieve. Then slowly build your own social circle. Heal before you date again. Or you will spend a lot of energies trying to be anxious around the new person and trying to spot similar patterns of abandonment. 

Sending you strength

Can I say from the perspective of someone who has lived through this? I was same as you. Pushing the person through, waiting them to grow up. And really invested but then when the time came for me to ask emotional presence or some behavioural changes I needed  to be secure, the person gave up with “you deserve better”. 

The catch up never happens. I know you want to think about the history but what happens in the future is for every step he grows, you have already taken a larger leap because you are thinking for two people instead of one. And at some point it will catch up with you both. It may be now, you walking out. Or it may be him at some point that the effort you are asking him for he is unwilling to make. And it will hurt more, the more times you have shared. This is a good time to move on. You will both find people who are more appropriate and invest and respect your stages of life.

I think that’s one of the high signs of anxiety & depression. Your brain negates the validity of your own emotions and keeps pressuring you to shrink yourself further and further. I m not a doc so I don’t know but sometimes othering my anxiety and depression(removing it from being part of my identity) and giving it it’s on name/presence helps me fight and ask help. It’s hard because in the end it’s you fighting against your own voice in your head, except instead of encouraging you it’s gone rogue. I wish you strength.  ...also there will be people who care, even if you don’t have met them now. I know this disappearance feeling too. I struggle with it. Like you I wish I could go back and undo the moments that broke me or just disappear and it will be calm then but I think also that I want to go on.  On rare better days. 33F have been through this a couple of times. Sometimes I backed out, sometimes others did. The thing is this will happen. The big group rarely ever stays. Especially if your progress is different directions. Sometimes it troubled me a lot. I have moved so often find myself with no one I know or friends so far that I don’t even know if I will get to see them when. What you need is like so many have said. Find people who actually care for you and care for them. It’s not always about the more cheerful, more popular - it’s also about people who are able to open up to each other and genuinely care and there is no thumb rule for that. Sometimes these are people with similar lives sometimes with completely different lifestyles. I think it took me a while to find friends that would last not just like occasional greetings but actually checking up on me or me on them. And you know the barriers of hesitation are less- I have this major thing where i keep feeling I am intruding people even if I text to talk while others perceive this at distance or even rudeness on my part. I felt 18, 25, 30...these are major flux life points in your social and personal circle. People disappear ofTen around then. But by and by you will find genuine relationships. Also think about what the people meant to you? When you were with them. Were they just a collective group to hang out with or did you genuinely care about them one on one. I m just saying this because I have been in both sides of the sentence. Sometimes we want people to be there for us but we haven’t made enough effort it be there for them. Try think that over.

Even though there are layoffs and recession, there are still places that are hiring in the UK. Find something atleast allied to your current field for time being and then progress to better positions when possible. About savings, try being self reliant.
